title: Embodied fly, stage 4c: inside the two one-step margins, does movement still fail before the chip flags? A finer dose grid for GABA-A potentiation and excitability block (SIMULATED)
status: registered before any of the finer dose levels was run
relation_to_parent: Stage 4b found the chip late in every family (R1 passed) but left two thin margins: without the bitter-gated proboscis, GABA-A potentiation ties the chip at the top dose (R2 failed); and in excitability block the chip's first run would tie movement at dose 0.4. Stage 4b's outcomes stand. Stage 4c asks a new question inside those dose steps, as the motor-level tie-break (preregistration/fly_motor_tie_break.json) did. Decision D22 in report/DECISION_LOG.md.
seen_before_registration: every stage-4b result, including its movement medians and disruption indices: GABA-A potentiation 0.423 (gaba_scale 1.25), 0.9841 (1.5), 2.1451 (2.0); excitability block 0.1181 (threshold_scale 1.1), 0.3564 (1.2), 2.6776 (1.4), 4.4578 (1.6); without the bitter-gated proboscis GABA-A potentiation's index at 1.5 is just below 0.5

the chip's |delta log2 mfr| in the parent's first run (conditions_SIMULATED.csv): GABA-A potentiation 0.199, 0.452, 0.992; excitability block 0.124, 0.167, 4.322, 4.322; and in its replication (confirm_conditions_SIMULATED.csv): 0.205, 0.447, 0.997; 0.118, 0.18, 0.38, 4.322

design.movements: exactly stage 4b (seeds 1360-1375, the three movements, medians, the disruption index against the vehicle of the same seeds, impairment at >= 0.5)
design.chip: the parent design's spontaneous recordings (FlyWire 783, the fixed planar array, 10 s) on both of its seed sets: the replication's (700-702) against the replication's vehicle, and the first run's (100-102) against the first run's vehicle; |delta log2 mfr| >= 0.5 is a detection
design.series: per family, stage 4b's (or the chip table's) coarse levels together with the fine levels, ordered by dose
design.onset_rule: the lowest dose on the combined series at which the readout reaches its line
design.resolution: chip later if the movement onset is the lower dose, chip earlier if the chip's is lower, still tied if equal or if neither reaches its line

F0_coarse_levels_reproduce.statement: Precondition: rerunning the coarse levels with the same seeds gives the recorded values
F0_coarse_levels_reproduce.test: max |difference| <= 1e-9 for the movement medians against stage 4b and for |delta log2 mfr| against both chip tables; if not, F1-F3 are uninterpretable

F1_gaba_potentiation_chip_later.statement: Inside the step, movement still fails before the chip flags
F1_gaba_potentiation_chip_later.test: GABA-A potentiation resolves chip later against the chip's replication, with the three-movement index

F2_without_the_bitter_gate_chip_later.statement: Stage 4b's tie resolves in the headline's direction
F2_without_the_bitter_gate_chip_later.test: GABA-A potentiation resolves chip later against the chip's replication, with the index over the proboscis under sugar and the reach only

F3_excitability_block_chip_later_for_bot.statement: The excitability-block margin holds against either chip run
F3_excitability_block_chip_later_for_bot.test: excitability block resolves chip later against the chip's replication and against its first run, with the three-movement index

not_claimed_even_if_all_pass: anything about any compound in any animal or person: the knobs are transmitter-class scalings in a simulated fly; a pass means that in this simulated fly, inside the dose steps where the coarse grid could not tell, movement fails at a lower dose than the chip first flags
reporting: Every prediction with its value and pass/fail or uninterpretable; per family and per index (three movements; each leave-one-out) and per chip run, the onsets and the resolution; per fine level the movement medians, the disruption indices and the chip's |delta log2 mfr| from both runs; F0's largest difference. Reported beside stage 4b's outcomes, not in place of them.
